lines: Matthew Harris Arnold, Investor Selling Shareholder, is due proceeds from selling 2,442,738 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹36.89 crore are scheduled for on or about Friday, October 23, 2026, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Gain of ₹-1.68 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained shares locked for 6 months from allotment.
